scope: post-write readback uncertainty; mock tests only

cases.given: setItem returns successfully; subsequent getItem throws
cases.expected: status=unverified; do not report saved or unchanged; do not retry/rollback blindly

cases.given: E3-09 then getItem succeeds and latest valid record already includes intended stars
cases.expected: status=saved; no second setItem; no extra revision increment

cases.given: E3-09 then latest valid record does not include intended stars
cases.expected: under Web Lock re-read, monotonic-merge, write only if needed, verify readback; never lower other progress

cases.given: E3-09 then latest data is corrupt, unknown schema, or fingerprint collision
cases.expected: status=blocked; no overwrite of original data

cases.given: E3-09 then another tab successfully updates a different stage before verification
cases.expected: under Web Lock preserve both stage records and monotonic stars, do not lose newer data
